fit_explanation: Culture and photography must-haves are fully preserved: Amber Fort, City Palace, Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar and Pushkar Lake remain, with rain-proof indoor museums (Albert Hall, Amrapali, Birla Planetarium) on Day 2 morning for elders/kids. Balanced pace with vehicle assist, cable car, frequent rests and midday breaks respects medium walking tolerance for 8-person joint family.
plan_title: Jaipur & Pushkar 4-Day Rain-Adapted Family Heritage Plan
summary: 4-day Jaipur (3 days) + Pushkar (1 day) heritage plan for 8-person joint family, balanced for elders and kids with private vehicle support. Day 2 is fully indoor-adapted for heavy rain at 09:00, shifting Hawa Mahal and Jantar Mantar to a drier Day 3 afternoon. Preserves all culture and photography highlights with easy viewpoints, seated shows and sunset finales.
tradeoffs: Keeping 3+1 split preserves Jaipur depth while accommodating rain without adding hotel changes
Postponing Hawa Mahal and Jantar Mantar to Day 3 afternoon preserves photography must-haves but loses early-morning soft light and creates a packed Day 3 for elders/kids
Full indoor shelter on Day 2 maximizes comfort for elders/kids but requires packed Day 3 to recover icons
Adding Amrapali Museum and Birla Planetarium provides Low/Moderate crowd indoor alternatives but adds museum-heavy day vs original palace/observatory balance
